subject.title: feat(webui): reintroduce opt-in AI purpose titles for tool calls

question: Should enabled tool titles be restricted to a utility model on the session's provider, or may an explicitly configured cross-provider utility model receive raw tool arguments?
rationale: The canonical utility-model contract intentionally permits explicit cross-provider models, while this PR promises that commands and arbitrary plugin/MCP arguments never reach a provider the session was not already using; automation cannot choose that privacy and product boundary.

options.title: Require same-provider titles
options.body: Skip title generation when an explicit utility model resolves to another provider, preserving the documented no-new-egress guarantee.

options.title: Allow configured cross-provider egress
options.body: Honor explicit cross-provider utility models but clearly disclose in config help and docs that enabling titles sends tool arguments to that configured provider.

options.title: Keep deterministic rendering
options.body: Decline the provider-backed title surface and retain current main's deterministic tool rows.

recommendation.title: Require same-provider titles
recommendation.body: Skip title generation when an explicit utility model resolves to another provider, preserving the documented no-new-egress guarantee.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history introduced and removed the title path, and they authored the canonical issue proposing the opt-in policy.
